confidence_notes: The FX figure comes from a search result that quoted the RBA page, which showed 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 Nov 2026. I did not open the page itself. I ran one search for food and drink prices in Matsuyama. It returned crowd-sourced cost-of-living sites that disagree with each other. Those sites gave a cappuccino at about $2.9-3.2, a beer at about $2.2-5, an inexpensive meal at about $7-8 and a mid-range dinner for two at about $35. The beer, cocktail and wine anchors are uncertain. I set cocktail and wine from the usual Japanese price relationship to beer, with the cocktail at about 1.5 times the beer price and wine slightly above that. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Japanese regional-city lodging, including Dogo Onsen tourism demand. I did not search for accommodation or inspect any listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other Japanese regional cities of 500k people, such as Okayama, Kumamoto and Takamatsu. Prices are below Tokyo and Osaka, with tourism demand around Dogo Onsen and the Shimanami Kaido cycling route.
